methodology.isolation: Each profile used a UUID-scoped temporary organization and workspace inside one PostgreSQL transaction. The transaction was rolled back after evaluation.
methodology.latency_scope: Query embedding, database retrieval, and rank fusion. Document ingestion, document embedding, and metric calculation are excluded.
methodology.scope_note: This was one local run over a synthetic controlled corpus and is not a production latency guarantee.
methodology.rollback_verification: A database query for temporary chunk-eval workspaces returned zero rows after the comparison.

decision.result: Keep the current production chunking profile.
decision.reason: The smaller profile improved mean Precision@3 by only 0.007 while reducing mean Recall@3 by 0.040, creating 71.429 percent more chunks, using 6.936 percent more document-embedding input tokens, and increasing mean and tail retrieval latency.
decision.production_change: No chunking-default change is justified by this controlled benchmark.
